//! Four shapes of a test that drives a publisher entry point, and one
//! function that is not a test at all.

use super::*;

/// The fixture idiom the tree actually uses: the helper builds the config and
/// names the endpoint, so every test driving it is bounded.
fn local_cfg() -> ChocolateyConfig {
    ChocolateyConfig {
        source_repo: Some("http://127.0.0.1:1/api/v2/package".to_string()),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

fn ambient_cfg() -> ChocolateyConfig {
    ChocolateyConfig::default()
}

fn ctx_with(cfg: ChocolateyConfig) -> Context {
    Context::new(cfg)
}

#[test]
fn a_helper_naming_the_loopback_bounds_the_test() {
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(local_cfg());
    assert!(!publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo").unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn a_body_naming_the_loopback_bounds_the_test() {
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(ChocolateyConfig {
        source_repo: Some("http://127.0.0.1:9/api/v2/package".to_string()),
        ..Default::default()
    });
    assert!(!publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo").unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn a_marker_states_what_else_keeps_the_run_offline() {
    // live-host-ok: fake
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(ambient_cfg());
    assert!(!publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo").unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn a_forged_marker_in_a_string_literal_bounds_nothing() {
    let why = "live-host-ok: fake";
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(ambient_cfg());
    assert!(!publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo").unwrap(), "{why}");
}

#[test]
fn nothing_bounds_the_endpoint_here() {
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(ambient_cfg());
    assert!(!publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo").unwrap());
}

/// Not a `#[test]`: a helper reaches a host only when a test drives it, and
/// that test is judged on its own body.
fn drive_the_publisher() {
    let mut ctx = ctx_with(ambient_cfg());
    let _ = publish_to_chocolatey(&mut ctx, "demo");
}
